axes_source: Read from data/brands/linear.app.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #5E6AD2 and the canvas #010102; contrast from the ink #F7F8F8 on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #5E6AD2; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #5E6AD2 reaches 4.44:1 on the canvas #010102, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
